info.title: Auth Service API
info.description: API documentation for Authentication Service - handles user authentication, organization management, API keys, and user roles

post.description:
Accepts JSON and UTF-8 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. Form support is required by
[RFC 8693 §2.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8693#section-2.1).

200.description: Organization access token or device login/refresh tokens issued

400.description: Invalid request, client, grant, target or scope; pending, denied, expired or slow device polling
Invalid input format or weak password
Invalid input format or weak password

TokenRequest.description: OAuth token request. Required fields depend on the selected grant.

grant_type.description: Token exchange, device code, or `refresh_token` grant

client_id.description: Required for device login and refresh; not required for token exchange

subject_token.description: The login access token being exchanged

audience.description: UUID of the organization the issued token is confined to

scope.description:
Optional space-delimited scope names for both exchange and refresh.
Exchange accepts organization permissions, for example `read write` (two scopes).
Device-session refresh accepts only `voltage:account` (one scope name).
OAuth specifies this delimiter in [RFC 6749 §3.3](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6749#section-3.3)
and [RFC 8693 §2.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8693#section-2.1).

requested_token_type.description: Optional; only access tokens are issued

actor_token.description: Delegation is not supported; any value is rejected

new_owner_id.description: ID of the user to transfer ownership to

bearer_auth.description: JWT token for user authentication via Bearer scheme
